Subject: Question about the museum visit Saturday

Hi team, I booked two tickets for the Halden Museum of Natural History for this Saturday and wanted to confirm whether the guided tour is included in the entry price. My kids are especially keen on the fossil hall, so if there's a recommended order to see things in, that would help. Also, is there anywhere inside to leave a stroller? We'll be coming by bus from the north side. Thanks for any tips you can share.

Subject: Board meeting agenda change — November

Hello, I'd like to change the agenda for the November board meeting of Larkfield Analytics. The finance update should move ahead of the product roadmap, since two directors are joining by video only for the first hour.

Could you also add a ten-minute slot for the auditor's note on the Q3 figures? Our chair asked for that to be included.

Finally, please send the revised agenda to the board mailing list and confirm to me that it has gone out.

Best,
Priya Nandakumar
Company Secretary, Larkfield Analytics

Thanks for the help.
